headline: The weekly decision loop now survives the postseason, owner capital holds a measured long-horizon equilibrium, cloud-save security claims match their mechanism, and one exact artifact passed every gate from rendered pixels through stable staging and production.

items.title: Incremental postseason restores the inspect-plan-commit-resolve beat
items.evidence: One controlled-team game resolves per command; plans persist through save/resume; batch season simulation consumes every postseason gate.

items.title: Owner capital is a stationary football-operations economy
items.evidence: Obligations, runway, owner traits, need, and bounded distributions produce 19/32 year-zero willingness, $152.0M/$201.2M year-40 p90/max cash, and a 64–84 facility range with no club at the ceiling.

items.title: Release and security promises are mechanically true
items.evidence: Pages runs Playwright before publication; Gist checksums are called corruption detection and optional PBKDF2/HMAC is called authentication; realism CI preserves partial evidence.

items.title: One exact artifact reached production
items.evidence: SHA 92e4190a4221383c8352ea6321d65528cb449e74 and artifact ca66c9210c1efbd234c31d9f392ca70dd6aa03171b47c90057b32d02210767e7 agree across visual, performance, staging 14/14, production 10/10, and green workflow 32933281222.

followUps.title: Prove the admitted analytics beacon actually reports
followUps.evidence: A live pageview in Cloudflare Web Analytics is still unobserved.

followUps.title: Observe the first genuine opted-in cohort
followUps.evidence: Freshness, suppression, deletion, and abuse ceilings need real activity, never manufactured activity.

followUps.title: Make bind failures self-explanatory
followUps.evidence: Print both digests and the first differing files before exiting.

blockers.title: Public launch remains HOLD
blockers.evidence: Zoho receive/reply-as, explicit public-launch approval, authoritative lifecycle reconciliation, and applicable external Obelisk relying-party proof remain independent. Technical deployment does not satisfy them.

honestyLedger.title: The first production run failed and was not bypassed
honestyLedger.evidence: Shallow Git history changed sitemap lastmod values and the artifact digest. Full-history checkout fixed the cause; the exact bind stayed strict.

honestyLedger.title: Studio-wide IGNIS mutation was not run from this public repo
honestyLedger.evidence: The detector ran read-only. Live mode writes sibling repositories, which CANON-018 forbids outside Studio Ark.

honestyLedger.title: The entropy computation passed but the shared writer rejected this repo
honestyLedger.evidence: It computed 0.051 healthy, then required a private Studio schema absent from the public repo. The exact computed value was recorded through the local canonical status format.

diffStat.suite: Node 1,280/1,280; Playwright 54/54; responsive 251 local states plus 236 final-CI required states; staging 14/14; production 10/10; doctor 0 blocking failures.
